heading: Words referring to acts include illegal omissions.
text: In every part of this Code, except where a contrary intention appears from the context, words which refer to acts done extend also to illegal omissions.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
